lines.en: When I walk, my feet never touch ground.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，就少一个我。
lines.en: Every step I take leaves one fewer of me.
I'm here, and I'm somewhere else.
My long arms hang below my knees.
I pass through blocks and they don't break.
The air behind me is still closing up.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，看起来很急。
lines.en: I walk slowly and look urgent.

lines.zh: 我的头偏了一下，偏得不对。
lines.en: My head tilts, and tilts wrong.

lines.zh: 我在追一个刚才的影子。
lines.en: I'm chasing a shadow from a moment ago.
I leave no footprints.
I take one step and the sound comes twice.

lines.zh: 世界在我经过的地方闪。
lines.en: The world flickers where I pass.
I stand, and my position is uncertain.

lines.zh: 我在原地，像一段没加载完的。
lines.en: I'm right here, like something not finished loading.

lines.zh: 我的手在动，不是我让它动。
lines.en: My hands move and I'm not the one moving them.
I've stared at one point for a long time.

lines.zh: 这里的方块，我看着就掉色。
lines.en: The blocks I look at lose their color.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，声音没出来。
lines.en: I open my mouth and nothing comes out.

lines.zh: 我能听见你的名字被念出来。
lines.en: I can hear your name being read out.
The black on me is deeper than night.

lines.zh: 我自己也不知道我在等什么。
lines.en: Even I don't know what I'm waiting for.
I blink, and a stretch is missing.

lines.zh: 远处有方块在慢慢消失。
lines.en: Blocks are slowly disappearing in the distance.

lines.zh: 我数了数自己的手指，多了一根。
lines.en: I count my fingers. There's one extra.

lines.zh: 天空那边，像有扇门开着。
lines.en: Over there the sky looks like an open door.
Someone put the torch out.
Don't look at me. Looking at me is a mistake.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在我身上，我感觉得到。
lines.en: Your eyes are on me. I can feel it.

lines.zh: 上一个看我的人，还在找路。
lines.en: The last one who looked at me is still finding his way.
I turn my head and you step back.
This face of mine is put together wrong.

lines.zh: 你听见那个声音了吗？那是你。
lines.en: Do you hear that sound? It's you.

lines.zh: 我认识你，在另一个版本里。
lines.en: I know you. In another version.
Your outline is flickering.

lines.zh: 我一伸手，你的屏幕会黑。
lines.en: If I reach out, your screen will go dark.
Don't count my joints.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，刚才没有你。
lines.en: You weren't standing there a moment ago.
I don't blink, so you lose.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我就记住一步。
lines.en: Every step you take, I memorize it.

lines.zh: 这里的名字，叫错了会出事。
lines.en: Name things wrong here and something happens.

lines.zh: 我还没动手，你先看了我。
lines.en: I haven't moved, and you looked at me first.
Your heart skipped a beat.

lines.zh: 我在这儿，你的影子不在。
lines.en: I'm here, and your shadow isn't.
You want me to go away. So do I.

lines.zh: 别闭上眼，闭上就换地方。
lines.en: Don't close your eyes. Close them and you'll be elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我的嘴在动，但我在听你说。
lines.en: My mouth is moving, but I'm listening to you.
A hole has been knocked into me.
Pain, but not in the right place.
My edges are shedding.

lines.zh: 这一下，把我拆开了一点。
lines.en: That took a little of me apart.
I hurt in two places at once.
Did you hit me, or not?
My voice has jammed.
I'm missing a stretch of memory.
Not there. That part is empty.
I'm back, and I brought the wound.

lines.zh: 你把东西递过来，我接不住。
lines.en: You hand it over and I can't hold it.

lines.zh: 那东西在闪，像我的影子。
lines.en: It flickers like my shadow.
I reach out and my hand is elsewhere.

lines.zh: 这一块，能补上我的洞吗？
lines.en: Could this patch the hole in me?
I pick it up, then set it down.

lines.zh: 我不想吃，但我的手想要。
lines.en: I don't want to eat, but my hands do.

lines.zh: 你留着吧，我拿了会弄丢。
lines.en: Keep it. I'd only lose it.

lines.zh: 它在你的手里，也在我的。
lines.en: It's in your hand, and in mine.
That smell is my own.
I shouldn't touch these things.
You hit me and went through.
We overlap, then separate.

lines.zh: 我的手臂擦过你，你没感觉。
lines.en: My arm brushes you and you feel nothing.
That one shook your picture.
I step back, and I haven't moved.
You hit the me from a second ago.

lines.zh: 我身上的黑蹭到你身上了。
lines.en: The black on me rubbed off on you.
Don't lean on me; this part of me is broken.
Our sounds overlap.
And I'm back where I started.
I shouldn't have a companion.
There's a me standing beside me.

lines.zh: 我们互相看着，都没有脸。
lines.en: We look at each other, both faceless.
It reaches out. I reach out.

lines.zh: 中间那段距离，量不出来。
lines.en: The space between us can't be measured.

lines.zh: 它说话了，用的是我的声音。
lines.en: It speaks, in my voice.
I try to join with it, and it won't.
We were one to begin with.
It comes apart into a few blocks.
I stay here, missing half of myself.

lines.zh: 它的坐标，不在这个世界。
lines.en: Its coordinates don't belong to this world.
It's in my hand, in the wrong place.
I put it away and can't find it later.
This thing shouldn't be here.
I push it into a block.

lines.zh: 它消失了，我的手还在找。
lines.en: It vanished and my hand keeps searching.
I hold it, and it's also elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我放进嘴里，味道是一片白。
lines.en: I put it in my mouth; the taste is white noise.
It's far too heavy for its size.

lines.zh: 我放下了，我怕它带走我。
lines.en: I set it down. I'm afraid it will take me with it.
I've worked out where you are.

lines.zh: 我看见了，但我不在你看得见的地方。
lines.en: I see you, from where you can't see me.
In that direction things are leaking.
I've fixed on that outline.

lines.zh: 你动了，我就知道你在哪。
lines.en: You moved, so I know where you are.
It isn't one thing.

lines.zh: 我听见脚步，比我多一双。
lines.en: I hear footsteps: one pair more than mine.
The blocks there are hollow.
I've marked this spot.

lines.zh: 我可以过去，也可以已经过去。
lines.en: I can go over, or I can already have gone.
I chose the latter.

lines.zh: 空气在我前面先坏掉了。
lines.en: The air ahead of me breaks first.
Something is calling me over.
That voice sounds like mine.
I'm behind it now.
It hasn't turned yet.

lines.zh: 它每动一下，我就多一个。
lines.en: Every time it moves, there's one more of me.

lines.zh: 我在它前面，也在它后面。
lines.en: I'm in front of it, and behind it.
It turns and I'm somewhere else.

lines.zh: 它看不见我，我就在它眼里。
lines.en: It can't see me, and I'm inside its eyes.
Distance doesn't behave here.
My reaching hand arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 它在跑，跑的是同一个圈。
lines.en: It's running, and it's the same circle.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经站在它脚边。
lines.en: My shadow is already at its feet.

lines.zh: 我不用追，我就在前面等。
lines.en: No need to chase. I'm waiting ahead.
It looks back at nothing.

lines.zh: 周围的声音全被吞掉了。
lines.en: All the sound around us has been swallowed.

lines.zh: 它能听见自己的心跳，很响。
lines.en: It can hear its own heartbeat. It's loud.
I'm counting them.
On the seventh, I move.
The sky is losing its color.
The torch went out. Good.
It can't see anything now.
This much I can still do.

lines.zh: 我的手已经贴到它肩上。
lines.en: My hand is already on its shoulder.
It hasn't noticed.

lines.zh: 我一抓，抓到的是一段空白。
lines.en: I claw and catch a stretch of blank.
It's pulled into my place.

lines.zh: 我的手臂绕过它，从前而来。
lines.en: My arm goes around it and comes from the front.
That one shattered its picture.

lines.zh: 它倒下了，声音延迟很久。
lines.en: It falls, and the sound arrives much later.
I step on its shadow.

lines.zh: 它喊我的名字，我听见了。
lines.en: It calls my name. I hear it.
I shouldn't have a name.

lines.zh: 我把手抽回来，手上多了东西。
lines.en: I pull my hand back, and there's something on it.
Its blood is black, like mine.
It's still moving, and it isn't moving.
I back off and it repeats in place.
I've seen this loop before.
Last time, it was me that fell.
I stand in two places, watching it.
All right. This stretch is over.

lines.zh: 我出现的时候，天已经错了。
lines.en: When I appeared, the sky was already wrong.

lines.zh: 这里的方块有一块是空的。
lines.en: One block here is simply empty.

lines.zh: 我先是一个轮廓，然后才有身体。
lines.en: First I'm an outline, then a body.

lines.zh: 我的名字被人念错了一次。
lines.en: Someone read my name out wrong once.

lines.zh: 我从一个洞里来，洞在我后面。
lines.en: I came from a hole, and it's right behind me.
Your torches go out, starting with me.

lines.zh: 这地方比我记得的更亮。
lines.en: This place is brighter than I remember.

lines.zh: 我抬手，那边的树掉色了。
lines.en: I raise a hand and the trees over there lose color.

lines.zh: 有脚步声，很多，都不属于谁。
lines.en: Footsteps, many of them, belonging to no one.
I stand and wait for the world to acknowledge me.
It never acknowledged me.
So I let myself in.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛，在别处睁开了。
lines.en: My eyes have opened elsewhere.

lines.zh: 你身后那块地，现在归我。
lines.en: The ground behind you belongs to me now.
Don't turn around. I'm behind you.
Don't go forward either. That's me too.

lines.zh: 这道天空的裂缝，是我带来的。
lines.en: This crack in the sky came with me.

lines.zh: 数到三，你就会看见两个我。
lines.en: Count to three and you'll see two of me.
I count the first shadow.
The shadow splits in two.

lines.zh: 火在我身上找不到可以烧的。
lines.en: The fire can't find anything on me to burn.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，掉了很久都没落地。
lines.en: I fall for a long time and never land.
The water can't get in, and I'm drowning.

lines.zh: 炸开的光，把我照出了两层。
lines.en: The blast light shows me in two layers.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，钉在后面的方块上。
lines.en: The arrow passes through me into the block behind.
This spell knows me.
I have no stomach, and I'm still empty.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我，我的形状变成了别的。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and my shape becomes something else.

lines.zh: 我终于回到了我来的地方。
lines.en: At last I'm back where I came from.
